name: Focus Long — pullback in uptrend, top 5
spec: 48-name universe; 60-day log-price trend (signal uses closes to t-1); buy top 5 by slope x R2 among names with -1.5 < residual < 0; equal weight, rebalance daily at the closing auction; 5 bp x turnover.
deviations: Prices: Yahoo split/dividend-adjusted closes instead of the original adjusted official closes.
backtest_note: Backtest on Yahoo daily history from the first date at least 80% of the 48 names traded (the original engine's coverage rule).
